baseline.meaning: Only public sitemap entries and GitHub Actions created after the prior observation are treated as follow-up candidates.

autoEnrichment.interpretation: The checked-out workflow updated 15 existing rows while logging zero parsed nutrients for every row. This is not a new product record and is not counted as a meaningful nutrition enrichment.
autoEnrichment.localRepair: The local script now leaves a row unchanged when the official response yields zero structured nutrition facts, no longer writes name-derived summaries, tags verified C003 facts with provenance, hides legacy unmarked facts from public nutrition surfaces, and rotates the enrichment cursor to avoid first-page starvation.

duplicateCoverage.command: npm run audit:content-duplicates -- --slug=supplement-label-reading-guide --title=영양제 라벨 읽는 순서: 기능성·원료명·섭취량 --delay-ms=100

decision.newDeltaArticle: not created because all four public sitemap datasets have zero entries after the baseline
decision.followUp: add the zero-delta and zero-nutrient interpretation to the existing monthly draft
decision.evergreenDraft: create one noindex label-reading guide from the previously verified 989 supplement paths and three non-recommendation samples
decision.claimBoundary: A blank structured field does not prove that an ingredient is absent, and a site tag does not prove functionality, efficacy, or safety.

officialSources.name: 식품안전나라 건강기능식품 검색
officialSources.use: product identity, company, report number, and registration-date lookup

method.publicData: Fetched same-origin public sitemap XML sequentially and counted lastmod values at or after the prior observation.
method.actions: Inspected GitHub Actions metadata and logs read-only; no workflow was dispatched.
method.writing: All Korean body copy was written directly in the active Codex session without an external writing API.
method.writes: No production database write, API write, publication, commit, push, or deployment was performed.

limitations: The public sitemap is a point-in-time view and does not expose every internal field mutation.
The enrichment log proves that the parser produced zero structured nutrients; it does not prove that the products contain no nutrients.
Legacy nutrition facts without the foodsafetykorea:C003 source marker are intentionally hidden from public detail, comparison, and sitemap signals until authoritative re-enrichment.
Production database values were not queried because no database credential was available in the local environment.
